_comment: The 中央線 SYSTEM's service-pattern sheet — the source for the E233-0
patterns-overview view. Spec: docs/wip/WIP_e233_0_display.md section 14.
This is network data, not run data. It describes every service the real
sheet shows, including the three this repo holds no diagram for, and it is
never inferred from route.json. It lives in the per-line pool rather than in
a diagram folder because all three Chuo diagrams draw the same sheet.
The axis is 1654T's stops, REVERSED — 32 names, split 15 | 17 at 高円寺 |
阿佐ヶ谷 — so they are copied rather than retyped and join cleanly on the
small-ヶ forms. Not pre_stops + stops: that diagram's 8 pre_stops (大月 …
相模湖) are off this sheet, and including them yields 40. It is NOT derivable
from whichever diagram is loaded: 602H's own list runs 青梅 to 立川 to 東京, a
different axis entirely.
COVERAGE IS ALL-OR-NOTHING. A service missing here is invisible on screen,
because five lines where six exist looks like a complete diagram.
Colours: 通勤特快 / 中央特快 / 快速 are the type_color their own diagrams
authored (602H / 916H / 1654T). The other three have no diagram, which is why
all six are stated here rather than looked up — a lookup could not answer for
half the sheet. validate_data.check_sheet_colors asserts the three that CAN be
cross-checked, and check_system_sheets asserts every station name here is on
the axis and in translations.json. Three of the six do NOT match the colours
measured off the reference — see WIP § 14.4, which records why that reading is
not trusted enough to overwrite authored data.
Stops were MEASURED off the reference, slot by slot, by testing each slot
centre for a near-white marker (_e233_lower_geometry.py --overview). Two
slots are AUTHOR-SUPPLIED because nothing is drawn there to measure:
立川, on all five rapid services — the junction pill covers the whole slot.
Sampled inside it (canvas x 412..424, y 252..296) not one of the six
service colours appears. The probe first reported four of the five as
measured, which was it reading the pill's own white 立川 kanji as marker
cores: the strokes cross four of the six line rows and 快速's row falls
in the gap between 立 and 川, so the split looked like a finding. The
probe now refuses any slot named in junctions[].
日野, on 快速 only — the junction spur's outermost stub runs to x 453.4 and
that slot's centre is 452.1, so the stub sits on the orange line there.
The other services' stubs converge above it and leave their slots clear.
The stops themselves are right; it was the provenance that was wrong.
